intro.fr: Undertale Yellow se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Undertale Yellow can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Pugie38/Undertale-Yellow-AP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Undertale Yellow.
text.en: The GitHub repository Pugie38/Undertale-Yellow-AP, home of the Undertale Yellow APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, Undertale Yellow AP v0.1.
text.en: The first version, Undertale Yellow AP v0.1, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.3.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (12 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.3.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (12 versions released).

text.fr: Undertale Yellow figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Undertale Yellow is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
